title: BizFlood Policy Conditions — Deductibles, NFIP Attachment and Commencement of Coverage
content:
**Condition 1 — Deductible.** Under BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines), each location carries the policy's flat deductible per occurrence, chosen from the tier's flat deductible options and not below the tier's lowest flat deductible per location; a location in zone V or VE instead carries the tier's zone V percentage of that location's value at the time of loss, never less than the tier's minimum zone V deductible.

**Condition 2 — Attachment on BizFlood Excess over NFIP.** On the BizFlood Excess over NFIP tier the attachment per location is the tier's building attachment and contents attachment, and the insured must keep the NFIP General Property Form policy in force; the excess never drops down.

**Condition 3 — Commencement.** Coverage takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the day that falls the tier's standard waiting period, in calendar days, after the signed application and payment are received, or on the loan closing date when bound for a commercial loan closing with the application received by that date; a location added mid-term takes effect the tier's added-location waiting period, in calendar days, after its request is received.

Until coverage attaches the policy stands as pending effective; it becomes active at 12:01 a.m. on the effective date.

## Condition 1 as a decision

| Location's flood zone | Deductible carried per occurrence |
|---|---|
| Any zone other than V or VE | The policy's flat deductible, which is one of the tier's options and not below the tier's lowest flat deductible |
| V or VE | The zone V percentage of the location's value at the time of loss, or the minimum zone V deductible if that is higher |

The zone V deductible is measured on the value of that one location at the time of loss, and it takes the place of the flat deductible for that location.

## Condition 2 in plain terms

On BizFlood Excess over NFIP the coverage sits above the NFIP General Property Form policy at the attachment for each location. The insured must keep that NFIP policy in force, and the excess never drops down to take the place of the NFIP layer.

## Condition 3 — counting and boundary cases (hypothetical dates and a hypothetical 15-day period)

The clock for new business starts on the day the signed application and payment are received; the effective date is that day plus the waiting period in calendar days, and coverage attaches at 12:01 a.m. on that date.

| Situation | Effective date |
|---|---|
| Signed application and payment received on 3 May, no loan closing | 12:01 a.m. on 18 May |
| Bound for a commercial loan closing on 10 May, application received on 10 May | The loan closing date, 10 May — the application was received by that date |
| Bound for a commercial loan closing on 10 May, application received on 9 May | The loan closing date, 10 May |
| Bound for a commercial loan closing on 10 May, application received on 11 May | Not received by the closing date, so the loan closing basis is not met; the standard waiting period counts from receipt of the signed application and payment |
| Location added mid-term, its request received on 3 May | 18 May |

"By that date" includes the closing date itself: an application received on the loan closing date satisfies it, and one received the day after does not.
